name: attach_script_safe
title: attach_script_safe
description: Writes a GDScript file and attaches it to a node. Before attaching, the script's `extends` line is checked against the node's actual class, and the file is compiled by the engine — if it does not parse, a newly created file is deleted again and the node is left untouched. Omit 'node' to only create the file; omit 'source' to attach a script that already exists.

node.description: Path of the node to attach to, relative to the scene root ('.' is the root). Omit to write the file without attaching it.

path.description: Destination file. Defaults to res://scripts/<node_name>.gd in snake_case. Parent directories are created as needed.

source.description: Full GDScript source. If omitted and the file does not exist, a minimal `extends <node class>` stub is generated.

base_class.description: Base class for the generated stub. Defaults to the target node's class. Ignored when 'source' is given.

class_name.description: Optional `class_name` line for the generated stub.

overwrite.description: Allow replacing an existing file. Without this, writing over a file is an error.

replace.description: Allow swapping a script that is already attached to the node.

dry_run.description: Validate and report without writing or attaching anything.

created.description: True when the file did not exist before this call.

errors.no_open_scene: A node was given but no scene is open.
errors.node_not_found: The 'node' path does not resolve in the open scene.
errors.node_not_editable: The node belongs to an instanced sub-scene.
errors.invalid_path: Script paths must be res:// and end in .gd.
errors.file_exists: The file exists and 'overwrite' was not set.
errors.script_already_attached: The node already has a script and 'replace' was not set.
errors.incompatible_base: The script extends a class the target node does not inherit from.
errors.script_load_failed: The engine could not parse the script; a file created by this call was removed again.
errors.write_failed: The file could not be written (permissions, read-only project).
errors.mkdir_failed: The parent directory could not be created.
